title: Derivations of plane algebroid curves
summary: In this paper, we study the derivations of an irreducible plane algebroid curve $R:=\frac{k[[X,Y]]}{(f)}$, which is not regular. Since the normalization of $R$ is isomorphic to $k[[t]]$, every $k$-derivation of $R$ is induced from a $k$-derivation of $k[[t]]$, which are of the form $a(t)\frac{d}{dt}$ for some $a(t)\in k[[t]]$. We establish a lower bound on the $t$-order of a nonzero power series $a(t)$ for $a(t)\frac{d}{dt}$ to induce a derivation of $R$ in terms of the multiplicity of $R$. We also prove a related result for the value semi-group of such curves.
